<title level="1" right="Action">[Hair Barrage](/Actions.aspx?ID=2796) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 95

</column>

---

The tarantula flicks its legs, flinging spiky hairs in a 15-foot cone. This deals 4d6 piercing damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. This damage increases by an additional 1d6 for every 4 levels you have beyond 6th.
name: Hair Barrage
